title.value: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety.
title.provenance: An act to add Chapter 12.5 (commencing with Section 108945) to Part 3 of Division 104 of the Health and Safety Code, relating to product safety.

location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

reference.provenance: AB  652,  Friedman.  Product  safety:  juvenile  products:  chemicals: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances.

status.provenance: [Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.]

date.provenance: [Approved by Governor October 5, 2021. Filed with Secretary of State October 5, 2021.]

pfas_definition.provenance: 'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a  class  of  fluorinated  organic  chemicals  containing  at  least  one  fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: This bill would, on and after July 1, 2023, prohibit a person, including a manufacturer, from selling or distributing in commerce in this state any new,  not  previously  owned,  juvenile  product,  as  defined,  that  contains regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.

date.provenance: This bill would, on and after July 1, 2023, prohibit a person, including a manufacturer, from selling or distributing in commerce in this state any new,  not  previously  owned,  juvenile  product,  as  defined,  that  contains regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.

who.provenance: This bill would, on and after July 1, 2023, prohibit a person, including a manufacturer, from selling or distributing in commerce in this state any new,  not  previously  owned,  juvenile  product,  as  defined,  that  contains regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.

action.provenance: This bill would, on and after July 1, 2023, prohibit a person, including a manufacturer, from selling or distributing in commerce in this state any new,  not  previously  owned,  juvenile  product,  as  defined,  that  contains regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS), as defined.

products.provenance: 'Juvenile product' means a product designed for use by infants and children under 12 years of age, including, but not limited to, a baby or toddler foam pillow, bassinet, bedside sleeper, booster seat, changing pad, child restraint system for use in motor vehicles and aircraft, co-sleeper, crib mattress,  floor  playmat,  highchair,  highchair  pad,  infant  bouncer,  infant carrier, infant seat, infant sleep positioner, infant swing, infant travel bed, infant walker, nap cot, nursing pad, nursing pillow, playmat, playpen, play yard, polyurethane foam mat, pad, or pillow, portable foam nap mat, portable infant sleeper, portable hook-on chair, soft-sided portable crib, stroller, and toddler mattress.

value: A children's electronic product, including, but not limited to, a personal computer, audio and video equipment, calculator, wireless phone, game console, handheld device incorporating a video screen, or any associated peripheral such as a mouse, keyboard, power supply unit, or power cord.
An internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product.
exceptions.provenance: 'Juvenile product' does not include any of the following: (A)  A  children's  electronic  product,  including,  but  not  limited  to,  a personal computer, audio and video equipment, calculator, wireless phone, game  console,  handheld  device  incorporating  a  video  screen,  or  any associated  peripheral  such  as  a  mouse,  keyboard,  power  supply  unit,  or power cord. (B)  A medical device. (C)  An internal component of a juvenile product that would not come into direct contact with a child's skin or mouth during reasonably foreseeable use and abuse of the product. (D)  An adult mattress.

intentionally_added.provenance: 'Regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'regulated PFAS' means either of the following: (1)  PFAS that a manufacturer has intentionally added to a product and that have a functional or technical effect in the product, including, but not limited  to,  the  PFAS  components  of  intentionally  added  chemicals  and PFAS that are intentional breakdown products of an added chemical that also have a functional or technical effect in the product.
